experiment.title: SPY intraday STDEV strategy replay (technical stack)
caveats: Each day uses MockOrderManager with ~$100k starting equity and is replayed independently; total_pnl_sum is the sum of per-day P/L, not a compounded equity curve.
Without premarket artifacts, the loop disables news/bias context and does not run the production Gemini periodic overlay — this measures the STDEV execution core only.
Past simulation does not imply future live performance.

linkedin_snippets: Replayed the STDEV day-trading engine on SPY for three historical sessions (2025-04-30 → 2025-05-02): 29 bracketed mock fills, combined daily P/L about +$628 on a fixed per-day bankroll (not compounded).
This batch isolates the technical MR/TC + risk stack — no premarket bias file and no in-session Gemini overlay, so it is an execution-core baseline rather than full production behavior.
